summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor for an original issue discount convertible promissory note of up to $1,150,000 principal with net proceeds up to $1,000,000; $625,000 received to date. Proceeds repaid existing notes and amounts owed to Blackberry AIF. Issued 200 million restricted shares as consideration. Note bears 12% interest, matures December 31, 2027, convertible at 70% of lowest trading price, subject to 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
